summary: @onereach/idw-ui-components ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: Package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs uses obfuscated identifiers and downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip` into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. The sibling `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (numeric array `n7gIxM=[...]` plus rotator `WV8StW`) that is not human-inspectable from Node tooling. The stated package purpose is a small UI-helper library exporting a single `formatIdwSummary` function; fetching an alternate language runtime at install time solely to execute a large opaque bundle has no relation to that purpose. The alternate runtime is used specifically to evade Node-based static inspection of the executed payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
